destinymod.configuration.title: Example Mod Configs
tooltip.destinymod.throwing_hammer.title: THROWING HAMMER
tooltip.destinymod.throwing_hammer.desc:
Throw a hammer forged from <keyword:Solar> energy. Picking up <ability:Throwing Hammer> refunds melee energy.

Cooldown: 10s
tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.title: MELTING POINT
tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.desc:
While <keyword:Sol Invictus> is active, <ability:Throwing Hammer> inflicts targets with <keyword:Melting Point>.

Targets affected by <keyword:Melting Point> take more damage from all sources, and the threshold to trigger an <keyword:Ignition> is reduced.
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.title: HEATSEEKER
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.subtitle: Sunbreaker Aspect
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.desc: <ability:Throwing Hammer> homes in on targets and applies significantly more <keyword:Scorch>.
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.title: ANVIL DROP
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.subtitle: Sunbreaker Aspect
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.desc:
<ability:Throwing Hammer> is much slower and heavier, but deals significantly more damage. 

When <ability:Throwing Hammer> hits the ground, it triggers a small <keyword:Solar> explosion which grows stronger based on its falling velocity.
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.title: SOL INVICTUS
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.subtitle: Sunbreaker Passive
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.desc:
Final blows from <keyword:Solar> abilities, <keyword:Scorch>, and <keyword:Ignitions> have a chance to create a <keyword:Sunspot>. Your abilities regenerate faster while standing in a <keyword:Sunspot>. 

<keyword:Sunspots> damage targets inside and apply <keyword:Scorch>.
death.attack.destinymod.sunspot: %1$s was engulfed in the corona of %2$s
